description: Extracts structured data from a FatturaPA/SDI XML e-invoice AND, in the same call, runs an anti-fraud check on the chosen party (default: the CEDENTE, i.e. the supplier who receives the bank transfer). The checked data are NOT inferred by an LLM: VAT number, Codice Fiscale, company name and payment IBAN are extracted deterministically from the XML, then passed to the checks: IBAN (MOD-97 checksum + bank from the ABI code), VAT number and CF (checksum) and — when the EU service is reachable — the real registered name via live VIES, compared with the one stated on the invoice. Returns the full parse plus `supplier_verification` with a verdict (ok / non_verificabile / attenzione / alto_rischio = ok / not verifiable / caution / high risk) and specific red flags; if the invoice carries several distinct IBANs it flags it and lowers the verdict. It is the defence against the IBAN-change fraud on incoming invoices. Like `verify_payee` it performs external I/O (a single VIES query per call, not one per line): if VIES is down or the shared budget is exhausted the verdict degrades HONESTLY to "attenzione", never to a false "ok". Free (€0), no login. It does NOT replace out-of-band verification (a phone call to the supplier on an already known number).

expected_country.description: Expected supplier country, ISO2. If omitted, the country stated by the invoice itself (the cedente's seat) applies, and only failing that 'IT'. A foreign IBAN on a supplier expected to be Italian is fraud warning sign #1.

party.description: Party to check: 'cedente' = supplier/payee (default, the anti-fraud case); 'cessionario' = customer. The IBAN is collected only for the cedente, because the cedente is the one who gets paid.

xml_content.description: The XML content of the electronic invoice (FatturaPA/SDI). A .p7m must be unwrapped first: plain-text XML only.

name: parse_verify_fatturapa
title: FatturaPA: parse + supplier anti-fraud check
